summary: Simplified Parent Access Flow testing completed successfully. All 13 backend API tests pass (100%). Frontend UI fully functional with all required features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: POST /api/parent/add correctly adds parent email with 'active' status immediately (no invite code needed)
Backend: GET /api/student/linked-parents returns proper structure with link_id, parent_email, added_at, max_parents, slots_remaining
Backend: DELETE /api/parent/remove/{link_id} correctly removes parent and returns success message
Backend: Maximum 2 parents validation works correctly (returns 400 when limit reached)
Backend: Duplicate email validation works (case-insensitive comparison)
Backend: Legacy /api/parent/invite endpoint redirects to new flow for backwards compatibility
Frontend: FamilyScreen.js has 'How it works' section with 4-step explanation
Frontend: Add Parent form has email input (data-testid='parent-email-input') and Add button (data-testid='add-parent-btn')
Frontend: Parent list shows email, added_at date, and remove button (data-testid='remove-parent-{idx}')
Frontend: Slots remaining counter updates correctly
Frontend: Toast notifications show for add/remove actions
seed_data_creation: Test parents created during backend tests are cleaned up at start of each test. Some test parent emails remain in DB from test runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simplified Parent Access Flow fully tested. Frontend: FamilyScreen at /family route shows 'How it works' section, Add Parent form (when slots available), and list of parents with remove buttons. Maximum 2 parents per student enforced.
